Todd J. Kantor decreased its stake in Marathon Oil Corp (Call) (MRO) by 55.72% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Encompass Capital Advisors Llc sold 2.01M shares as the company’s stock declined 6.39% with the market. The hedge fund run by Todd J. Kantor held 1.60M shares of the oil & gas production company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $27.01M, down from 3.60 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Encompass Capital Advisors Llc who had been investing in Marathon Oil Corp (Call) for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $15.45B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.90% or $0.35 $18.11. About 7.28 million shares traded. Marathon Oil Corporation (NYSE:MRO) has risen 7.25% uptrending. It has underperformed by 4.30% the S&P500.
